newspec-a: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
Nursing Home (API): pass — get null, no row names the id in any patient-linked table, audit for the patient = before + 1 delete row with the earlier PHI_READ kept, control unchanged. Hospital (API and card trash icon -> OK): chart, list projection and every other table clean, audit trail correct, control unchanged, BUT the Quick Dictation compartment placed on the deleted patient survives: quickDictationDrafts row with assignedPatientId = the deleted id, assignedLabel '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …', and the dictated text; the Quick Dictation screen after the delete still lists '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …' with Dictate / Re-assign. The confirm dialog read: 'Remove <name> from the rounding list? This will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data for this patient.'
产品问题: After a physician deletes a Hospital patient (trash icon -> OK), opening Quick Dictation still shows a compartment labelled with the deleted patient's room and full name ('412 · <name>') holding what was dictated for them; the stored quickDictationDrafts row still points at the deleted chart. Fails TC-01/S20's oracle, which lists quickDictationDrafts among the patient-linked tables that must hold no row naming the id (TFA-92579 AC 2: 'immediately (hard delete, not hidden)'). deleteRoundingPatient (convex/rounding.ts) never touches quickDictationDrafts. Overlaps TC-24 Q6(a) (whether the compartment and its 'room · name' label must go) and is already listed in the TC-24 risks.

descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D5 · P0 · Daniela

删除病人后，快速口述里还留着写着他姓名、房号和口述内容的框，要不要一起删？

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S20 「硬删除在两个模式下都是立即的、完整的；之前的访问记录保留；旁边的病人不受影响」 Hard delete is immediate and complete in both contexts; the earlier access trail stays; the neighbour is untouched

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept.（TFA-92579 AC 2；UAT TC-24）
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-01；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Per context, a target and a control patient. Hospital target: pre-round text, a task, a medication row and a Quick Dictation placement. NH target: pre-round text, a task and a medication row (Quick Dictation is Hospital only). access.logChartAccess called on each target, so a PHI_READ row exists

When Delete each target through rounding:remove / snf:remove, and once more through the card's trash icon → OK (when S17's runner exists); read the backend on the first query after the mutation returns (no sweep, no cron)

Then get(id) is null; zero rows reference the id in every patient-linked table; audit_logs by_patient(id) = count before + 1 delete row and the earlier PHI_READ row is still there; the control patient's rows are unchanged

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：AC 2 'immediately (hard delete, not hidden)' + 'audit log … kept'. A deleted flag, a removed list row with the document left behind, a cascaded PHI_READ row, or a changed control row fails. Whether the Quick Dictation compartment text itself must go (not only its assignment) is TC-24 Q6. Hospital UI half overlaps TC-24 S13; …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa

医生删除一个医院病人后，病历和数据都删了，但快速口述里还留着一个写着该病人房号和全名的框，里面是给他口述的内容。

After a physician deletes a Hospital patient, the chart and its data are gone, but Quick Dictation still shows a box labelled with that patient's room and full name, holding what was dictated for them.

依据：newspec-a (API and card trash -> OK). The Nursing Home half passes; the audit trail is kept and the control patient is unchanged. A quickDictationDrafts row keeps assignedPatientId = the deleted id plus the label '412 · <name>' and the text, because deleteRoundingPatient never touches quickDictationDrafts. This is exactly TC-24 Q6(a), which asks whether the box must go, and it is listed in the TC-24 risks. The leftover link to the deleted id fails the S20 oracle whatever Q6 decides; if Daniela agrees, Tim fixes it.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local (dev partial: get(id) null and missing from the list through user functions, as in S17) 跑；来源：newspec-a。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S20

Hard delete is immediate and complete in both contexts; the earlier access trail stays; the neighbour is untouched

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New api spec, per context a target and a control: Hospital target with preRoundNotes, a task, a medication row and a Quick Dictation compartment assigned to it; NH target with preRoundNotes, task, medication. logChartAccess on each target. Delete via rounding:remove / snf:remove; on the first read after: get(id) null, admin system reads of every patient-linked table (roundingPatients/snfResidents, *List projections, quickDictationDrafts, unassignedRoundingItems, handoffs) find no row naming the id, audit rows for the patient = before + 1 delete row with the PHI_READ still there, control rows byte-identical. UI half (trash icon -> OK) on the Hospital card too. — All reads are admin system reads on the local stack; deletion is the app's own mutation / card control.

Detail:

Nursing Home (API): pass — get null, no row names the id in any patient-linked table, audit for the patient = before + 1 delete row with the earlier PHI_READ kept, control unchanged. Hospital (API and card trash icon -> OK): chart, list projection and every other table clean, audit trail correct, control unchanged, BUT the Quick Dictation compartment placed on the deleted patient survives: quickDictationDrafts row with assignedPatientId = the deleted id, assignedLabel '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …', and the dictated text; the Quick Dictation screen after the delete still lists '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …' with Dictate / Re-assign. The confirm dialog read: 'Remove <name> from the rounding list? This will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data for this patient.'

产品问题：After a physician deletes a Hospital patient (trash icon -> OK), opening Quick Dictation still shows a compartment labelled with the deleted patient's room and full name ('412 · <name>') holding what was dictated for them; the stored quickDictationDrafts row still points at the deleted chart. Fails TC-01/S20's oracle, which lists quickDictationDrafts among the patient-linked tables that must hold no row naming the id (TFA-92579 AC 2: 'immediately (hard delete, not hidden)'). deleteRoundingPatient (convex/rounding.ts) never touches quickDictationDrafts. Overlaps TC-24 Q6(a) (whether the compartment and its 'room · name' label must go) and is already listed in the TC-24 risks.

证据：附了 8 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our api spec, not written yet): it seeds, logs chart access and adminQueries every patient-linked table and audit_logs with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
